thread.title: Apple Completes Shazam Acquisition

author: nasdaq.com
title: Apple Completes Shazam Acquisition
text:
September 24, 2018, 12:50:00 PM Apple Inc. ( AAPL ) on Monday said it successfully completed acquisition of Shazam, one of the most popular music identification app.
"Apple and Shazam have a long history together. Shazam was one of the first apps available when we launched the App Store and has become a favorite app for music fans everywhere," said Oliver Schusser, Apple's vice president of Apple Music. "With a shared love of music and innovation, we are thrilled to bring our teams together to provide users even more great ways to discover, experience and enjoy music."
In December, Apple had announced it was acquiring Shazam and its development team for about $400 million. However, the acquisition was delayed after an investigation by the European Union over potential antitrust concerns. However, regulators gave approval earlier this month.
Shazam lets users identify songs simply by listening to the music playing around them. Apple has announced that it will be removing all ads from the app "soon," including the Android version. Shazam has been downloaded over 1 billion times around the world, and users identify songs using the Shazam app over 20 million times each day. //www.rttnews.com/2937601/apple-completes-shazam-acquisition.aspx
